notes: Coarse, probeable capability vocabulary. Roughly one ID per harness tool. An operation declares the minimum set it needs; if any one is missing the operation cannot bind to that channel. Discipline: every ID must be probeable by a harness profile, coarse enough to be one tool, and non-overlapping with its neighbours.

text.generate.desc: Produce prose or structured text from a prompt.

text.summarize.desc: Condense longer text into a shorter form.

text.classify.desc: Assign labels or categories to text.

text.extract.desc: Pull structured fields out of unstructured text.

image.generate.desc: Create a new still image from a prompt.

video.generate.desc: Create a new moving-image clip from a prompt or image.

ml.infer.desc: Run a trained model over inputs.

media.assemble.desc: Compose, mux, trim or encode media. FFmpeg class.

media.probe.desc: Inspect media properties: duration, codec, resolution.

format.render.desc: Render a template into a document or graphic without a model.

code.exec.desc: Run code in an interpreter or sandbox.

validate.schema.desc: Check data against a schema or contract.

git.op.desc: Perform a version-control operation: clone, commit, tag, push.

external.call.desc: Generic fallback for an unrecognised external dependency. Never treat as 'requires nothing'.

secret.oauth.desc: A user-authorised OAuth grant for a third party.

secret.apikey.desc: A user-supplied API key for a paid provider.

secret.read.desc: Read a secret from a vault or secret store.

db.migrate.desc: Apply a schema migration to a database.

vector.search.desc: Query a vector index by similarity.

search.index.desc: Write documents into a search index.

payment.charge.desc: Move money or bill a customer.

notify.message.desc: Send a message to a person or channel.

schedule.cron.desc: Register a recurring or future execution.

container.op.desc: Build, run or push a container image.

human.decide.desc: A person makes a judgement call.

human.review.desc: A person inspects an artefact for correctness or rights.
